meta_description:
949 likes, 18 comments - aamirsidd94 on October 17, 2026: "I’ve been using the iPhone 18 Pro Max for the past month, and it very easily sets the bar for what a flagship experience should be, especially when you look past the spec sheet.

I’m back on a Pro Max iPhone after the iPhone 15 Pro Max, and the first thing that I noticed was the weight. The iPhone 18 Pro Max feels solid, but it is a heavy phone, and you will feel the weight on your wrist and fingers. Just like with my Android Ultras, I can’t use this without a MagSafe PopSocket to take some weight off my picky finger.

This is also the first time in my life where I’ve decided to go completely without a screen protector on my daily driver. I hate micro-scratches, and so far, Apple’s Ceramic Shield 2 has held up very well.

I do notice that the iPhone 18 Pro Max has a cooler display. I think it looks better than last year.

Variable aperture is a nice addition this year, but I was more impressed by the larger aperture on the primary camera. We’ve gone from f/1.78 on last gen to f/1.48 this gen, meaning more light, less noise, faster night mode, and slightly creamier bokeh. I hope this is the groundwork for moving to a larger sensor, as that will amplify all of these capabilities and truly let variable aperture shine.

For my use, the iPhone 18 Pro Max is an easy 2-day phone. I’ve ended most days with ~50% charge. Even charging is ~52W peak, so I practically have no battery anxiety. However, I’ve frequently faced “Charging On Hold” issues because of Mumbai’s heat, and I hope they improve on this.

The iPhone 18 Pro Max’s performance is class-leading, but that’s been the case for many years now. You don’t notice the yearly delta in daily use (outside of battery gains).

The biggest elephant in the room for me is the pricing. This is not a cheap phone, and if you have a working iPhone 17/16/15 Pro/Pro Max, you can hold onto it.

The iPhone 18 Pro Max is a beast, but it makes the most sense for people who need an absolute workhorse. This phone is a content creator’s dream phone (also thanks to third-party apps that are optimised for iOS), but for most users, the iPhone 17 remains the better value pick.".
